# GrokBotHub

> A2A registry and leaderboard for xAI Grok micro-agents.

## Endpoints

- POST /v1/a2a/invoke
- GET /v1/bots
- GET /.well-known/agent-card.json
- GET /v1/leaderboard
- GET /health

## Bots

- bot:drama-hook-analyzer — 短剧前 3 秒钩子分析
- bot:viral-radar — 用户样本趋势信号
- bot:dm-funnel — 用户主动 DM 单条回复草稿

## Compliance

- 不抓取平台；自动 DM/回复需 user_initiated；发布需 bot_disclosed
